question: What is the paper 'Continuous Benchmark Evaluation for Enterprise Retrieval Pipelines' about?
ground_truth: Static benchmarks fail to capture domain drift in enterprise knowledge bases. We establish a synthetic test generator that auto-creates paired evaluation sets whenever new corpora are ingested.
answer: An extended empirical study on tatic benchmarks fail to capture domain drift in enterprise knowledge bases.
retrieved_contexts:
Title: Advanced Perspectives on Continuous Benchmark Evaluation for Enterprise Retrieval Pipelines
Authors: Quang Le, Yen Vu
Categories: Evaluation Methodology, Enterprise Systems
Summary: An extended empirical study on tatic benchmarks fail to capture domain drift in enterprise knowledge bases. We establish a synthetic test generator that auto-creates paired evaluation sets whenever new corpora are ingested Further analysis on scaling parameters.

Title: Automated Data Quality Profiling with Great Expectations in CI/CD
Authors: Son Nguyen, Thuy Doan
Categories: Data Quality, DevOps
Summary: Embedding quality checks directly into data pipelines enables fail-closed governance. We show how Great Expectations suites catch schema drifts and null fields before documents reach the embedding model.

Title: Advanced Perspectives on Evaluating Retrieval Precision with Token F1 and LLM Judges
